$comment: Schema and example for docs/sprint-logs/{SprintID}/reopen.json. Written when a Story/Sprint that was previously marked done is re-opened — either by autopilot review (classification ① AC violation) or by an explicit user request to retroactively re-open a past Sprint. Records why and when, so the history of 'a done Sprint became in_progress again' is auditable.

$rules.when_written: On Sprint re-open. See autopilot/SKILL.md → Review Mode (① AC violation) for the milestone_review path, and the backward-compatibility policy for the manual_retroactive path.

triggered_by_semantics.milestone_review: Re-opened by autopilot review at a milestone boundary because a user request was classified as ① (an existing AC was not actually satisfied).
triggered_by_semantics.manual_retroactive: Re-opened by explicit user instruction targeting an already-completed past Sprint (§2.9.5). autopilot NEVER sets this autonomously — past Sprints are not auto-rewritten.

$rules.state_changes_applied: When a Sprint is re-opened, the caller ALSO mutates docs/ROADMAP.json: Sprint status done → in_progress; affected AC status pass → fail with a reopened_at timestamp added; fix tasks/Stories appended; progress.done recomputed. This file is the log of that mutation, not a substitute for it.
$rules.backward_compatibility: Optional, on-demand (§2.9). Absent file ⇒ '再オープン履歴なし' (no re-open history). Never back-generated.
